name: Iori
message: 「Whoops, that’s right. My apologies.」

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone, back away. I’m about to begin sparring practice with Momiji.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Understood. Everyone, let's go.」
Setsugekka, Asahi, and Ririmu shuffle back toward the wall.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Teacher! Please, take down Momiji! Go get her!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Good luck to you too, Momiji.」
They both draw their Origami and face each other.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, I am truly honored to finally receive guidance from Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「You’ve got a sarcastic way of putting that.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Considering you exposed my secrets and dragged me out here by force, I think I’m entitled to at least that much.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, I suppose you’re right.」
I laugh lightly and raise my Origami.

name: Iori
message: 「In this sparring session, I want you to judge for yourself whether I’m truly qualified to be your teacher.」

name: Momiji
message: 「And if I decide you aren’t？」

name: Iori
message: 「Then tell me what to improve. I’ll comply as best I can.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’d prefer it if you just left me alone, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「This is a mission, so that’s impossible.」
A sharp murderous intent dwells in Momiji’s eyes.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Even for a training bout, I won’t be holding back, so don't expect it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course. Show me your full strength.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I expect nothing less than your full strength as well.」

name: Iori
message: 「Understood. Let’s begin！」
I close in on Momiji, aiming to shorten the distance.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I won't let you get close.」
Momiji reacts instantly.
Utilizing the reach of her long blade, she blocks my approach long before my own blade can reach her.

name: Iori
message: 「Then I’ll just have to force my way through！」
Because the blade of a long sword is so long, it’s inevitably less agile in close quarters.
If I aim for the opening right after she deflects my strike—

name: Momiji
message: 「Do you really think you can get within my range with that level of pressure？」

name: Iori
message: 「Heh, I’m impressed...」
Momiji countered with her long blade at a speed nearly equal to, or perhaps even exceeding, my own swing.
While long blades are often unwieldy and lead to sluggish movement, Momiji handles hers as if it were a standard sword.
Her skill is arguably already on par with professional Jindou athletes.

name: Iori
message: 「Then, how about this！！」
I tried to pin down her incoming blade from above to force a blade lock, but—

name: Momiji
message: 「Naive！」
Far from backing away, Momiji lunged straight at me.
She slid my oncoming blade along the length of her own, maneuvering behind me—

name: Momiji
message: 「Haaaaah！！！」
She spun and slashed at my defenseless back, but.

name: Momiji
message: 「...You managed to block that well.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that was a close one.」
Still facing backward, I had parried the flash directed at my spine with my Origami.

name: Iori
message: 「As expected of someone who boasts they have nothing left to learn.」

name: Iori
message: 「Your skill is beyond reproach.」
I turned to face her and reset my guard with my Origami.

name: Iori
message: （Man, that long blade is quite the nuisance.）
The difference in reach between Momiji’s blade and mine is about 50 centimeters.
Even accounting for arm length, she still has a 30-centimeter advantage.
For Setsugekka or Ririmu, that reach difference would be over 40 centimeters.
Speed is essential to closing that gap, but Momiji can wield her weapon as fast as a normal sword.
Given that, I have to say it’s nearly hopeless to bridge the distance.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmph, I wouldn’t mind if you surrendered now to save yourself the embarrassment.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I’ll be fine regardless, but I’m worried about how I’m going to get the other students to overcome you, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Are you looking down on me？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Save that ‘I’ll be fine’ attitude until you at least land a single strike on me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, you’re right. My apologies.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Honestly! This time, I’m the one coming for you...!!」

name: Iori
message: 「Pretty sharp...！」
She lunged in—and the very next instant, a relentless flurry of strikes.
I somehow managed to parry them, yet her masterfully swift return strokes showed none of the drawbacks of a long blade, leaving me no opening to counterattack.

name: Momiji
message: 「I told you, didn't I? I want you to get serious！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Is this all you've got when you're serious, Sensei?！」

name: Iori
message: （This is a little rough...！）
Her blindingly fast flurry with that long blade forced me to give ground.
She was too fast for me to close the distance, and with her superior reach, none of my counters could land.
As a result, I ended up forced completely onto the defensive.

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't disappoint me with something like this！！！」
She'd slipped a trick move―a feint―right into the middle of her flurry.

name: Momiji
message: 「You'd do well not to assume the same move will work on me repeatedly？」

name: Momiji
message: 「After all, I remember every single move you make.」
Ah, that's right.
Momiji possesses a terrifying gift for foresight—reading her opponent's patterns from the briefest of exchanges.
The overwhelming despair of falling further and further behind the longer the fight goes on. An ordinary academy student could never endure it.

name: Iori
message: （Now I understand why you don't expect anything from teachers...！）
Momiji wasn't overconfident, nor was she arrogant.
At Murakumo Academy, there wasn't a single teacher capable of surpassing her skill and teaching her what lay beyond.
She had merely been stating that stark, undeniable fact...

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei...！」
The battle was heading in an unexpected direction.

name: Ririmu
message: 「H-Hey, hey, Kijo~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Isn't Sensei kinda in trouble？ He's gonna lose, y'know？」

name: Asahi
message: 「He'll be fine.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, but still~ Sensei can't do a thing against Momicchi.」
Just as Ririmu-san says, Momiji-san has been overwhelming Iori-sensei for a while now, making full use of her long reach.
Against the surging torrent of strikes Momiji-san unleashes, Sensei hasn't been able to return a single blow.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, Momicchi's like, insanely strong.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Can we even beat that？」

name: Asahi
message: 「It would be difficult as things stand, wouldn't it」
Momiji had hardly appeared in public before entering this academy. There was absolutely no record of her in the academy's database either.
And today, I had the opportunity to watch Momiji's match for the first time, but—

name: Asahi
message: （……To think that we are both first-years）
Fluid movements like flowing water, terrifying speed, and powerful strikes.
She is a top-class swordsman with no flaws to be found anywhere.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm, as I thought, even Muragaki-sensei can't beat Momimomi~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But that's okay！ I'm going to take down Momimomi myself！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san, I truly envy how carefree you are」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, what's that supposed to mean by 'carefree'~！」
You can generally tell a swordsman's caliber just by watching them spar.

name: Asahi
message: （As of now, the top of Takamura Class is undoubtedly Momiji-san. At this rate, I have no chance of winning……）

name: Asahi
message: （Aside from her berserk episodes, Setsugekka-san shouldn't be a threat. If she gets close, I can just cut her down in two and it'll be over.）
The idea that Setsugekka-san could beat Momiji-san, who is more skilled than I am, is just too reckless.

name: Asahi
message: （Ririmu-san is a bit tricky, but I can deal with her once I get better at reading her style.）
There is only one lingering concern: 'The secret with Iori-sensei'.
Sensei said I'd understand if we sparred, so I'll have to ask him for a match sometime.

name: Ririmu
message: 「C'mon Sensei, right there! Give it your best and strike back~!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm~, I wonder why Muragaki-sensei isn't counterattacking」

name: Asahi
message: 「Because his opportunities for counterattacks are all being blocked by Momiji-san in advance, that's why」

name: Asahi
message: 「Just watch…… Look, Momiji-san just attacked Iori-sensei's feet」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, yeah」

name: Asahi
message: 「That was Momiji-san seizing the initiative, anticipating that Sensei was about to shift his pivot foot forward」

name: Asahi
message: 「Sensei, being struck at, had no choice but to defend or dodge, effectively eliminating his option to step forward before he could even take it」

name: Asahi
message: 「That is how Momiji-san snips every bud of a counterattack before it can even sprout」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, I get it. It's like that feeling when someone puts a stick right where you're about to trip, right？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That is super annoying, isn't it~」

name: Asahi
message: 「Indeed. A wonderful analogy that even an elementary schooler could understand」

name: Ririmu
message: 「When you say it, it kinda feels like you're making fun of me」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「More importantly, Asahi-chan, you sure can tell a lot just from watching」

name: Asahi
message: 「In Iai sword-drawing, «counter-initiative» is everything」

name: Asahi
message: 「Without the insight to read an opponent's moves, Iai quick-draw simply cannot work」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I see~ Maybe I should train that too」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, watch my opponent really closely！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Everyone does that from the start. You're such an idiot, Ririmu-chan」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ I don't wanna be called an idiot by Takamura Class's resident airhead」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What a terrible prejudice！ I'm not the resident airhead！」
Setting the two of them and their noisy banter aside, I observe Iori-sensei and Momiji-san's mutual sparring.

name: Momiji
message: 「How long do you plan to stay on the defensive, Iori-sensei！！」
Iori-sensei remains stuck on the defensive, still unable to launch a counterattack.

name: Asahi
message: （I never imagined Momiji-san was this skilled）
Pinning Iori-sensei down like this would be impossible without extraordinary skill.
She might even be stronger than the current Toujinegi.

name: Asahi
message: （If I'm aiming to become Toujinegi, Momiji-san will be my greatest obstacle...！）
Transferring into Takamura Class was the right choice.
Being in the same class allowed me to recognize the threat early on, and from here on I can study her up close to find a way to counter her.

name: Asahi
message: （Momiji-san, as I am now, I probably can't match you）
Still, I will never give up.
I'll overcome every obstacle and become the Toujinegi, no matter what.
What I can do right now toward that end.
That is to burn this fight firmly into my mind.

name: Asahi
message: （Momiji-san... allow me to take the full measure of your strength！）

name: Momiji
message: 「What's the matter, Iori-sensei！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Weren't you going to prove to me you're worthy of being a teacher in this sparring match！！」
As I keep striking, irritation begins to well up inside me.
Iori-sensei's skill is genuinely impressive.
He's been neutralizing nearly all of my feint-laced attacks and blocking them cleanly.
Yet that's all he's doing.
Faced with my overwhelming barrage, Sensei couldn't advance a single step.

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I'll give it my best」

name: Momiji
message: （Putting on such a composed face—what a sly teacher...！）
Out of my multi-hit combo laced with feints, the final strike landed.

name: Iori
message: 「Whew, that's pretty impressive, Momiji」

name: Iori
message: 「I never expected you to have a move like that up your sleeve」
Iori-sensei, retreating far back to regain his stance.

name: Momiji
message: 「Iori-sensei, that's quite enough」

name: Iori
message: 「Hm？ What are you talking about？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I want to see you fight seriously」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wouldn't it be about time you used Tengen Saimei-ryuu？」
Iori-sensei's expression changed.

name: Iori
message: 「...How do you know about that？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I heard from Asahi-san. Apparently, it's a killing sword known as the Swordsman Slayer」

name: Momiji
message: 「If I'm your opponent, I shouldn't be found lacking, should I？」
Sensei, falling silent.

name: Momiji
message: 「Do you have any other way to break out of this situation？」

name: Iori
message: 「Mmm, this is a tough spot...」

name: Iori
message: 「I'd rather not use that if I can help it」
Just as Asahi said, it seems Iori-sensei dislikes Tengen Saimei-ryuu.

name: Momiji
message: 「Are you saying a killing sword is overkill against a mere academy student？」

name: Momiji
message: 「You're really underestimating me」

name: Momiji
message: 「I have no intention of forcing you, Sensei」

name: Momiji
message: 「However, I at least have no intention of learning anything from someone who has his hands full just defending against my attacks」

name: Momiji
message: 「As you are now, you aren't fit to be my teacher」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you want to be my teacher, prove your true strength right here」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, you’re quite the provocateur, aren't you.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I believe I am merely stating the obvious.」

name: Iori
message: 「Fair point, I suppose.」
An evasive, noncommittal reply—why is he acting so coy?

name: Iori
message: 「If you’re so desperate to see the Saimei-ryuu, why don't you try and drag it out of me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Maybe if you pushed me a little harder, you’d get to see it？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Trying to provoke me? Returning the favor, are we?」
I flash a smirk, and the teacher smirks back.

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, that’s right.」

name: Iori
message: 「You keep telling me to show you my true power, but you haven't shown me yours yet, have you？」

name: Momiji
message: 「My ‘true power,’ you say？」

name: Iori
message: 「That thing you did during your match against Victoria.」
Ah—so that’s it.
So Iori-sensei has been waiting for *that*.

name: Momiji
message: 「……Understood.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Then shall we both reveal our hands?」

name: Iori
message: 「Gladly. You go first.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't you dare go backing out later just because you’ve seen my full power.」

name: Iori
message: 「If I did that, you wouldn't recognize me as your teacher anymore, would you？」
Indeed, that would be putting the cart before the horse.

name: Momiji
message: 「Then, here I come—！」
Between the sparring sessions with Ririmu, Asahi, and Setsugekka, and the mutual practice sessions with me, I have generally “figured out” Iori-sensei.
Sword techniques used, telegraphs, reach, tactical algorithms, offensive and defensive skills, frequently used routines, combination patterns, and their combined probabilities.
Gaze, expressions, blinking, breathing technique, muscle reflexes, habits, weight distribution, blind spot management, and all other manner of physiological responses.
Psychological tendencies, personality traits, interpersonal judgment, logical reasoning ability, cognitive speed, stress tolerance, emotional regulation, and their strategic impact.
<center>It isn't perfect, but it will suffice for now.</center>

name: Momiji
message: 「—Shingan no Kiwamete, initiate！」
Switching neural circuits to ultra-high-speed predictive architecture.
First move, vanguard predictive actions... approximately 48 variations.
Second move, 26 effective counters against predictive tactic 1, 8 effective counters against tactic 2, effective counters against tactic 3—
The number of nodes in the second-move action tree is approximately 1,049.

name: Momiji
message: （Ah, damn it, there are too many！）
Teacher's movements are diverse, and his search nodes are increasing significantly faster than Victoria's.
In 0.08 seconds, I could only calculate 16 moves ahead, with roughly 1.2e+24 terminal nodes.
Filter by experience evaluation to derive the optimal solution.

name: Momiji
message: （Alright, 16th move: over 80% probability of checkmate！）

name: Momiji
message: 「Then, here I go—！！」
Move 1: Closing in with a mid―level torso sweep, full swing to the abdomen―hit.
Move 2: Attempting a mutual strike, a flash at the neck, reality consistency 86.708 percent—
Speed +20m/s faster than predicted, data correction—evaded.
Move 3: After reversing, an upper―level feint thrust followed by a drawing slash―hit.
Move 4: Attempting a mutual strike, a thrust to the head, reality consistency 88.032 percent—
Arrival time ―0.06 seconds earlier than predicted. Data correction―barely evaded.
Move 5: Utilizing moment of inertia, a spinning slash aimed at the thigh—opponent evaded.
Left foot step +0.51 seconds later than predicted. Physical strength +3.5k, data correction.
Move 6 evaded, Move 7 hit, Move 8 evaded, Move 9 opponent evaded—！ Evaded, hit, evaded, opponent evaded, evaded, evaded—！！
I should say as expected; Teacher reacted beyond my read, parrying more than half of my attacks.

name: Momiji
message: （But... this is the end！！！）
Move 15: A flat slash to the opponent's chest, reality consistency 99.975 percent—
0.13 centimeters lower than predicted—evaded.
Move 16: Countering in sync with the previous flat slash, severing the neck！
The timing is perfect. With this, Teacher is fin—
I cancelled all actions and retreated without regard for losing my center of gravity. Kicking off the ground, I pulled back sharply.

name: Momiji
message: 「...W-what was that」
Teacher's flat-slashed blade, which I thought had long since passed.
Suddenly—it snapped vertically upward, deflecting the blow I had aimed at his neck.

name: Momiji
message: 「Is such a movement even possible...？」

name: Iori
message: 「You were watching my training with Setsugekka, weren't you？ I use martial arts too.」
Iori-sensei tapped his foot lightly against the ground, *tap, tap*.
Looking closely, there was a depression in the ground the same size as Sensei's foot.
It seems he used the recoil from stomping his foot to alter the path of his blade.

name: Iori
message: 「Still, that flurry of attacks just now was incredible.」

name: Iori
message: 「Your aim was so precise that I couldn't dodge them all, as expected.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...For me, the fact that you dodged even half of them is enough of a threat.」
The Shingan no Kiwamete is my ultimate technique.
By flipping a switch in my mind, my brain transforms into a predictive processor that simulates the match before me at hyper-high speed.
However, it is merely a prediction, not precognition.
Since I cannot read what I do not know, it is vital that I understand as much of my opponent's arsenal as possible.
That is why, from the first time to the second, and the second to the third, the accuracy of the Shingan no Kiwamete increases exponentially with each repetition.
This sparring match with Iori-sensei is still in its first round.
I expect I'll be able to predict his movements even more accurately in the future, but—

name: Iori
message: 「Say, Momiji. Is it possible for you to keep that up for longer？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Of course it is.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm... the way you put that, it doesn't sound like it's infinite, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「Shall we test just how long you can keep it up?」

name: Momiji
message: （Tch~, he noticed after all！）
This Shingan no Kiwamete isn't all-powerful.
Depending on the level of temporal resolution I require, the limit is about one minute at most.
Beyond that point, noise and indeterminate factors accumulate, making it impossible to maintain sufficient accuracy.

name: Momiji
message: 「I don't mind testing it, but please don't forget our agreement.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Next, it's Sensei's turn to reveal your hand.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, right. I remember.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Show me what that 'Swordsman-Killer' lethal style is really capable of.」

name: Iori
message: 「...I'm not exactly keen on it, but I have no choice.」
Iori-sensei spreads his feet wide, angles his shoulder toward me, and draws his Origami, hiding his grip behind his body.

name: Momiji
message: （Is this... the Waki-gamae stance...？）

name: Iori
message: 「I'll only show this to you all once.」

name: Iori
message: 「The essence of the Muragaki, Tengen Saimei―ryuu―have at you！！」
The pressure radiating from the teacher had shifted.

name: Momiji
message: （W-what is this...！）
A terrifying killing intent, such as she had never been exposed to before.
An ordinary person would have been struck weak at the knees and withered away by this alone.
But this was merely the beginning.

name: Momiji
message: （W-what... what is being done to me！？）
Her body was pinned firmly to the ground, unable to move. She thought it might be a Tenju, but after 0.2 seconds of thought, she finally realized.
This was an instinctive terror.

name: Momiji
message: （Am I scared？ Just from facing him！？）
Impossible, that was absolutely impossible.
She had landed the first strike against the master swordsman—her grandfather, Suzakuin Masamori. Even then, she had never felt cowardly.

name: Momiji
message: （There must be a reason, there has to be a reason—！）
She frantically searched for the reason. Teacher Iori had simply been standing there in the same spot for a while now.
Yet why then—

name: Momiji
message: （...No, that's not it）
The teacher wasn't just standing there.

name: Momiji
message: （Tip of his blade raised by 1mm, center of gravity shifted downward by 0.83kN. Neck rotated -1.8 degrees, gaze shifting to his eyes, toes, waist, right index finger, left little finger...！）
Ah, is that it... no, but if that’s the case, then this is...！

name: Momiji
message: （You're kidding, what is this storm of feints and fakes...！！）
Predictive reading involves anticipating an opponent's next move based on minute behaviors: shifts in their center of gravity, muscle movements, gaze, and facial expressions.
The teacher was injecting a staggering amount of fakes into the very information needed for that predictive reading...！
...Deep within his dark, sunken eyes lay an unimaginable hostility and malice. A malevolence and bloodlust so vile it was sickening to even consider.
Scheming, plotting, deceiving. All to reap my life.
...This is no human feat. This was the work of an ogre or a demon.

name: Iori
message: 「What's wrong, Momiji? Aren't you going to do what you just did?」

name: Momiji
message: （Don't talk nonsense, there's no way I could do that...！）
No, what am I doing getting weak-willed. If I don't initiate, there is no future.

name: Momiji
message: （It's okay, this is just a fake. If I attack, he's bound to slip up—）

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha.」
She hurriedly shifted her center of gravity back.
Just as she was about to step forward, the teacher's feet seemed to hover in the air.
It was a move that seemed to seize her initiative, but was this also just a fake?

name: Momiji
message: （If that's the case...！）
Maintaining her distance, first to the side—
Iori-sensei’s gaze fixates precisely on where I intend to move.

name: Iori
message: 「Stalling for time doesn’t suit you, Momiji. Just come at me straight.」
My palms gradually grow damp with sweat. It’s been a long time since I was this nervous.

name: Momiji
message: （So this is the Tengen Saimei-ryuu, the Sword Killer’s murderous blade……！！）
I understood the true nature of the Saimei-ryuu, and why it is called the Sword Killer.
The stronger a swordsman gets, the sharper their ability to read the flow of battle.
This Saimei-ryuu targets such masters who rely on reading, trapping them in its own web.

name: Iori
message: 「What’s wrong? Not going to attack?」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Shut up, you should be the one attacking, Sensei！」

name: Iori
message: 「Tengen Saimei-ryuu holds a single strike to be the ultimate path to victory. So, I’m just waiting patiently until that becomes possible.」

name: Iori
message: 「Right until the moment you show a fatal opening.」

name: Momiji
message: （Oh, I see, so that’s how it is……！）
When facing a master of tactical reading, you subject them to a barrage of fakes, forcing them into extreme tension, and wait until they wither away.
And once you judge that their concentration has snapped, you bury them with a single strike. That seems to be the Muragaki way—the Sword Killer's code.

name: Momiji
message: （What a, what a sickening sword style……！？）
I feel like an ant trapped in an antlion's pit.

name: Iori
message: 「Don’t take it personally. You’re the one who said you wanted to see me get serious.」
That’s certainly true. I have no room to argue.

name: Momiji
message: （Sword Killer, aren't you just interesting……！！！）
He’s just throwing out fakes.
He’s not actually reading my tactical flow.
Even if Sensei were reading my flow to throw fakes, my prediction accuracy is far superior.
If so――！！

name: Momiji
message: 「――Shingan no Kiwamete, activation！！」
Click. I flip the switch in my brain with intensity.

name: Momiji
message: （I’ll tear off your mask, Sensei――！）
First move, vanguard predictive action…… approximately 2,620 variations.
Second move, 32 effective counters against prediction 1, 21 against prediction 2, effective counters against prediction 3――
……Number of nodes in the second move's action tree: approximately 71,539.
Third move: 19,777,687.
Fourth move: 5,104,953,283.

name: Momiji
message: （No way, tell me it's a lie...！）
By the 6th move, the terminal nodes surpassed 36 billion.
7th move 9.7e+16, 8th move 2.6e+19, 9th move 6.9e+21, 10th move—
By the 10th move at most, my brain was reaching its limit.
Even so, that's fine; I just need to run the experience evaluation function and find the optimal solution—
1.8e+24 terminal nodes; within that vast array of paths, the most suitable action is,

name: Momiji
message: （A mutual kill...？ And the success rate is only 6.32%...！）
If that's the best possible option, what happens if I take any other path?

name: Momiji
message: （No, that's impossible！ The experience evaluation function must be wrong！）
When facing Iori-sensei, evaluating based on previous experience is useless.
There must be a better evaluation method, I have to find it—

name: Iori
message: 「Hmph...!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eh, wait...」
By the time I realized it, the Origami had vanished from my hand...
And Iori-sensei's blade was pressed against my throat.

name: Iori
message: 「This is as far as you go.」
Ah... this is a total defeat.
Resetting all my thoughts, I exhale deeply, the tension leaving my body.

name: Momiji
message: 「...I yield. I surrender.」
